A run can span many turns (goal rounds, follow-ups, steering), each with its own `tur"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"n/end`; the plugin only remembers the **last** one.
2. **`agent/status` → `'idle'`**: the harness's "},{"id":"p12s4","text":"own "run ended" signal (the web UI's running indicator and `agent.whenIdle()` both derive from it). "},{"id":"p12s5","text":"When the root agent returns to idle, the whole activity has converged, so the plugin sends the recor"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"ded final result once and clears it."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"So **one notification per complete run**, not per turn: a multi-round goal run fires once at the end"},{"id":"p13s2","text":", with the final result; intermediate "task completed" moments never fire early. The title comes from the last `se"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"ssion/title` event in the session log — an async projection, so very early notifications (e.g. a que"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"stion right at session start) may not have one yet.
